source_text:
Title: Butter Chicken with Tandoori-Grilled Chicken and Silky Tomato-Butter Sauce
Servings: 4

Ingredients (component | amount unit | name | prep_style | pantry food_id):
- Tandoori Chicken | 600 g | chicken breast |  | 000044
- Tandoori Chicken | 150 g | plain yogurt |  | 000205
- Tandoori Chicken | 15 ml | lemon juice |  | IMP-0d29f9
- Tandoori Chicken | 1 tsp | ground ginger |  | 000282
- Tandoori Chicken | 15 g | garlic |  | 000112
- Tandoori Chicken | 1 tsp | ground cumin |  | 000278
- Tandoori Chicken | 1 tsp | ground coriander |  | 000279
- Tandoori Chicken | 0.5 tsp | ground turmeric |  | 000280
- Tandoori Chicken | 0.5 tsp | Cayenne Pepper |  | 000652
- Tandoori Chicken | 1 tsp | salted butter |  | 000211
- Silky Tomato-Butter Sauce | 80 g | butter |  | 000384
- Silky Tomato-Butter Sauce | 400 g | canned tomatoes |  | 000415
- Silky Tomato-Butter Sauce | 100 ml | heavy cream |  | 000219
- Silky Tomato-Butter Sauce | 100 g | onion |  | 000111
- Silky Tomato-Butter Sauce | 10 g | white sugar |  | 000358
- Silky Tomato-Butter Sauce | 0.5 tsp | ground cinnamon |  | 000281
- Silky Tomato-Butter Sauce | 0.25 tsp | ground cardamom |  | 000287
- Silky Tomato-Butter Sauce | 0.25 tsp | ground cloves |  | 000284
- Silky Tomato-Butter Sauce | 2 g | dried apricots |  | 000175

Steps in order (component | phase | minutes | text):
1. Tandoori Chicken | Prep |  | Mince the garlic and combine it in a bowl with plain yogurt, lemon juice, ginger, cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt, and cayenne pepper.
2. Silky Tomato-Butter Sauce | Prep |  | Finely dice the onion and set aside. If the canned tomatoes are whole, pulse them in a blender until perfectly smooth.
3. Tandoori Chicken | Prep |  | Cut the chicken breast into 3cm cubes. Ensure all pieces are uniform for even grilling.
4. Silky Tomato-Butter Sauce | Cook |  | In a large heavy-bottomed pan, melt 40g of the butter over medium heat.
5. Tandoori Chicken | Prep |  | Toss the chicken cubes in the tandoori marinade until well coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
6. Silky Tomato-Butter Sauce | Cook |  | Add the diced onions and sauté for 6-8 minutes until they are soft and starting to turn golden.
7. Tandoori Chicken | Prep |  | SAFETY: Thoroughly wash your hands, utensils, and any surfaces that came into contact with raw chicken.
8. Silky Tomato-Butter Sauce | Cook |  | Stir in the cinnamon, cardamom, and cloves. Toast the spices in the butter for 60 seconds until fragrant.
9. Tandoori Chicken | Cook |  | Preheat your oven grill or barbecue to 220°C.
10. Silky Tomato-Butter Sauce | Cook |  | Pour in the tomato puree and add the sugar. Simmer gently for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce reduces and darkens.
11. Tandoori Chicken | Cook |  | Thread chicken onto skewers or place on a wire rack over a baking sheet. Grill for 12-15 minutes, flipping once, until charred on the edges and cooked to an internal temperature of 75°C.
12. Silky Tomato-Butter Sauce | Cook |  | Lower the heat and stir in the heavy cream and the remaining 40g of butter. Mix until the sauce is silky and emulsified.
13. Tandoori Chicken | Serve |  | Remove the chicken from skewers and set aside to be incorporated into the sauce.
14. Silky Tomato-Butter Sauce | Cook |  | Add the grilled Tandoori Chicken pieces into the sauce. Simmer for an additional 5 minutes to let the flavors meld.
15. Silky Tomato-Butter Sauce | Serve |  | Rub the dried fenugreek leaves between your palms to release the oils and sprinkle over the hot butter chicken before serving.
